scope: 2026-10-16 graphics repair of the existing v0.5 working project
release_status: source changes applied; existing v0.4 executable and release archives have not been replaced
fixed: Ten aircraft now use generated transparent overhead art with registered central pivots; hull, embedded hyrax pilot and shadow rotate together.
Medic uses twenty new generated frames: outlined red/ivory medical emblem, two walking poses and cyan hand healing. All live medic actions bypass the old gun sprite.
Four hyrax infantry use twenty new aiming poses with registered muzzle points; baked flashes pointing sideways are no longer used while firing.
Owl headquarters and infantry gate were regenerated with complete uncropped upper spires.
Reviewed construction cells exclude disconnected neighbouring fragments; 117 construction PNGs rebaked with the current building dimensions.
Vehicle chassis suspension and walker leg movement use bounded cached mesh animation; turret recoil is independent.
Three planet cliff faces and matching floor materials regenerated; shared world-space UV warp, restrained material blending and slope shading reduce visible tiling and distinguish ramps from cliffs.
limitations: Aircraft use overhead image rotation, not independent perspective renders for every heading; depth and world-fixed lighting during turning are approximate.
New medic and infantry aiming art has five stored headings mirrored into eight views. Existing ground locomotion on the other units keeps its previous sixteen-direction mapping.
Vehicle gait is small procedural articulation of generated layers, not a fully rigged 3D walk cycle.
Terrain repetition is reduced, not eliminated. These checks do not certify StarCraft-level overall polish or match balance.
